title: Add chat command rate limiting and cmdQueue bounds
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — council finding P1-010

The `cmdQueue` in `MineflayerAdapter/index.js` is unbounded — a flood of commands can grow it without limit, leading to OOM. Additionally, there's no rate limiting on chat/command input to the adapter beyond the C#-side ChatRateLimiter (which only applies to LLM chat, not adapter commands).

**Impact:** A compromised or misconfigured client can flood the agent with commands, exhausting the Minecraft adapter queue, causing OOM, or triggering anti-spam kicks from the Minecraft server.

**Recommendation:** 
1. Add a maximum queue depth to `cmdQueue` (e.g., 100 items) — reject new commands when the queue is full.
2. Consider a per-endpoint rate limiter in the C# REST API for `/api/agent/*` POST endpoints.
3. Log a warning when rate limiting or queue bounds are hit.
